ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Sandeep Gupta and Persons Acting in Concert (PACs), identified as part of the Promoter Group of Asian Hotels (West) Limited, have increased their stake in the company through an inter-se acquisition. They acquired 200,000 shares, representing an additional 1.72% of the total voting capital, elevating their collective holding from 16.32% to 18.04%. This transaction consolidates the promoter group's control; however, being an "inter-se" transfer between related parties, it does not immediately suggest any red flags regarding compliance or market impact beyond a strengthening of existing ownership.
